page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.se1ne family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, featuring 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The hardware includes 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding 8.0 GB of RAM per core, which positions it as a memory-optimized resource. This instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, and it operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the instance exhibits lower-tier processing and memory performance. Single-core and multi-core CPU tests via stress-ng and Geekbench place the processor in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. Memory read bandwidth is also in the bottom 25%, though memory write bandwidth for large blocks reaches average levels. Cryptographic and compression tasks, such as single-threaded gzip compression, show poor performance, falling into the bottom 10%. However, Passmark CPU scores and extended instruction tests achieve average ratings, and small-model LLM inference with a 135M model registers average processing and generation speeds.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.se1ne.2xlarge is its high memory-to-vCPU ratio paired with modest processing speeds. While it lacks the computational throughput for intensive calculations or large-scale LLM inference, the 64.0 GB memory capacity provides qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require high-speed CPU performance. This profile is suitable for caching layers, lightweight database operations, and memory-intensive general-purpose workloads that can operate within a 2 Gbps network baseline.
